Statement: Group-mean waveforms (Buttner 2025) represent the design patient at each epoch

Expected effect: Individual deficits vary widely (Hadizadeh SD 0.184 N.m/kg on mean 0.311); peak-of-mean flattens and can shift timing
Verification / resolution plan: Assist-as-needed range via alpha; request individual/supplementary data; sensitivity +/- 1 SD

Justification / partial source: Garcia cohort 1.72 m; Evans-Pickett 1.718 m (similar ACLR populations)
Verification / resolution plan: Use design user stature; or use tau = dM[BW*h] x m x g x h directly

Statement: Body-mass scenarios 60 / 70 / 90 kg (70 kg = former PR-ASM-001 value kept as a scenario only)

Justification / partial source: Garcia Table 3 near-linear (max residual 8.7 ms); within-speed-range interpolation
Verification / resolution plan: Obtain ACLR cadence/stance time per epoch (e.g. Buttner supplement; Lin 2025 supplement)
